procedural_matters: The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
GBR 25 was represented by Jac Baily.
ARG 3330 was represented by Juan Cernadas.
Frederic Wood helm of GBR 3347 gave evidance as a witness for GBR 25.
facts: In race Q5 of the Red fleet, the wind was 14 knots.
The boats were sailing on a downwind course approaching mark 2p with GBR 25 on port tack and ARG 3330 on starboard tack, on converging courses.

GBR 25 gybed onto starboard tack and reached a broad reach course, 1 boat length above the starboard layline of mark 2p. At that moment she was 2 boat lengths clear ahead of ARG 3330 and 5 boat lengths from the mark.
When GBR 25 entered the zone of mark 2p, she was 1.5 boat lengths clear ahead of ARG 3330.
When GBR 25 was beside the mark and less than a boat length from it, ARG 3330 established an overlap to leeward of GBR 25 and sailed between her and the mark.
At that moment GBR 25 luffed slightly, and then gybed.
While the boats were rounding the mark, the distance between them was less than 1 meter.
conclusions: ARG 3330 not overlapped with GBR 25 and not in the zone at the time GBR 25 reached the zone, failed to give GBR 25 mark-room, and broke RRS 18.2(a)(2).
decision: ARG 3330 is disqualified in race Q5.
